metadata.title: GitLab Stock Soars After Earnings. It’s Still Not a Buy, Analyst Says.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
GitLab Stock Soars After Earnings. It’s Still Not a Buy, Analyst Says.
GitLab stock was surging on Wednesday—but investors should be wary of chasing that rally, even after a second-quarter earnings beat.
